Load penetration test on PS soil at relative density approx 0.52; apparatus: LPT fixture; loading: static penetration. Recorded: q/(D gamma) vs Df/D (average; log ordinate).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: unit weight, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
